messages:
ana: FYI the EdgeWave listing goes GA next Tue. We need a partner SEV flow that balances speed + partner privacy. Can we finalize today?
priya: I think shared Slack channels only for SEV1s. For SEV2s use ephemeral warrooms or private threads and invite partner liaisons as needed.
sam: +1. Proposed quick rules: SEV1 = customer-impacting outage -> open shared_channel + bridge + page on-call. SEV2 = degraded but working -> private warroom, invite partner if triage needs it, escalate after 30m if unresolved.
rahul: Note: marketplace shared channels must be pre-whitelisted. Priya, can you gather partner POCs and required scopes (read/post)?
priya: Yep. I'll compile a partner-access form and whitelist sheet. Also need to confirm whether EdgeWave prefers to post or just observe.
kyra: We should define clear severity criteria in the doc: my draft: SEV1 = service unavailable or data loss for paying customers. SEV2 = SLA degradation affecting >10% of traffic or key customers.
ana: small correction, that's ana not nana :)
ana: oops my bad ^^
ana: Ana: K. Let's lock owners and automation.
sam: I'll add a deploy-bot command: `/bridge create partner-edgewave --duration=72h --type=shared` which creates #edgewave-warroom, whitelists partner emails, and posts starter template. If creation fails, bot will post BRIDGE_FAILED and page eng-sre.
deploy-bot: bridge created: #edgewave-warroom (expires 72h)  invites sent to edgewave-poc@edgewave.com
rahul: Ops script (copyable) for SEV1:
1) Confirm severity and affected customers.
2) Run: `infra status partner=edgewave` for topology.
3) `/bridge create partner-edgewave --type=shared`
4) Page @eng-sre on-call: `pagerduty: SEV1 partner-edgewave`
5) Post starter message in the bridge (template below).

Starter template (paste into warroom):
"Hello  SEV1 declared for EdgeWave marketplace listing. Impact: X% requests failing for merchant IDs 42/84. Triage leads: @sam (SRE), @rahul (Support), @priya (Partner Success). ETA for first update: 10m. Logs: https://logs.redwood/integrations/edgewave/incident-<id>. Keep updates short: what, who, ETA."

priya: Add comms rule: no external customer announcements without PS/Sales signoff. Partner Success owns customer messaging and approval.
kyra: Fallback plan if shared channel cannot be provisioned quickly: 1) create private warroom in our workspace, 2) generate an invite link and send to partner POC, 3) create a conference bridge (Zoom) via deploy-bot.
sam: Automation rule: if `/bridge create` returns error, bot posts BRIDGE_FAILED and pages eng-sre with manual bridge steps.
rahul: Pin checklist in every partner warroom:
- One-line impact summary
- Steps already taken
- Next owner and ETA
- Handoff marker when resolved

ana: Security note: never paste secrets into the channel. Use sanitized log links and short IDs. For Private (on-prem/VPC) deployments, follow the Private onboarding runbook  partner warroom must be hosted per-customer.
priya: I'll finish the partner form + whitelist today and share the spreadsheet.
sam: I'll push bot changes and a short runbook into eng-runbooks.
kyra: I'll run a 15-minute dry-run on Friday for Support + PS to practice the ladder.
ana: Owners: Priya (partner access + comms), Sam (automation + runbook), Kyra (training), Rahul (severity definitions). We'll reconvene after the dry run. Thanks all :thumbsup:
